name: 隆太窯
what: 1974年に中里隆が見借に築いた窯で、中里太亀・健太も作陶する。展示室で作品を選べる。
whatEn: A kiln established by Takashi Nakazato in Mirukashi in 1974, where Taki and Kenta Nakazato also make pottery. Works are sold in the showroom.
note: 形と手触りの違いを、手に取って選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose by holding each piece, feeling the shape and texture.

name: 鏡山窯
what: 1969年に井上東也が開いた、鏡山のふもとの唐津焼窯元。土と釉薬を作り、薪窯で焼く工房に、直売のギャラリーを併設する。
whatEn: A Karatsu-yaki kiln founded by Toya Inoue in 1969 at the foot of Mount Kagamiyama. Clay and glazes are prepared by hand and the pots are wood-fired; a gallery sells the work.
note: 絵唐津の器は、まず筆の線を見て選びたい。
noteEn: With E-Garatsu, I would choose by looking at the brush lines first.

name: ギャラリー一番館
what: 呉服町の、唐津焼と有田焼を扱う店。1階は器の店、2階は作家の個展などを開くギャラリー。
whatEn: A shop for Karatsu and Arita ware in Gofukumachi. Tableware on the ground floor, with a gallery upstairs for potters’ exhibitions.
note: 普段の食卓に使う皿を、一枚ずつ選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose plates one at a time for the everyday table.

name: monohanako
what: 唐津とアメリカのメイン州で作陶する中里花子のショールーム。見借で皿や鉢を扱い、営業日は公式Instagramで知らせる。
whatEn: The showroom of Hanako Nakazato, who works in Karatsu and Maine, USA. Plates and bowls in Mirukashi; opening days are posted on the official Instagram.
note: 楕円の鉢に、何を盛るか考えながら選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose an oval bowl while thinking about what to serve in it.

name: ムローメ アートショールーム
what: 町田の、フュージングガラスと彫金の企画展を開く工房兼ギャラリー。常設展示はなく、春と秋の会期中だけ開場する。
whatEn: A studio and gallery in Choda holding exhibitions of fused glass and metalwork. No permanent display; it opens only during its spring and autumn shows.
note: ガラスのランプは、灯りの色まで見て選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose a glass lamp by the colour of its light, too.

name: 元祖 伊藤けえらん
what: 浜崎銘菓「けえらん」を作る和菓子店。県産うるち米の蒸した生地で餡を巻き、保存料は使わない。
whatEn: A wagashi shop making keeran, a Hamasaki sweet. Steamed dough made from prefecture-grown rice is wrapped around bean paste, without preservatives.
note: 県産米の生地で巻いたけえらんを、おやつに選ぶ。
noteEn: For a snack, I would choose keeran wrapped in dough made from local rice.

name: Tea & Space 基幸庵
what: 東唐津の舞鶴橋のたもとにある、喫茶と民藝品の店。唐津焼の器で抹茶と和生菓子、季節の甘味を出す。
whatEn: A tea room and folk-craft shop beside Maizuru Bridge in Higashi-Karatsu. Matcha and fresh wagashi in Karatsu ware, with seasonal sweets.
note: 器を見たあとは、抹茶と和生菓子の盆にする。
noteEn: After looking at the crafts, I would order the matcha and fresh wagashi tray.

name: 健太郎窯
what: 2008年に村山健太郎が築いた、鏡山の中腹の唐津焼窯元。山で採った土や石から粘土と釉薬を作り、日常の器を焼く。
whatEn: A Karatsu-yaki kiln established by Kentarou Murayama in 2008 on Mount Kagamiyama. Clay and glazes are made from earth and stone gathered in the hills, for everyday tableware.
note: 小皿を一枚、土と釉薬の表情で選んでみたい。
noteEn: I would choose one small plate by the character of its clay and glaze.

name: 三藤窯
what: 宇木で三藤るいが営む唐津焼の窯元。2009年に独立し、土探しから窯焚きまで行い、登り窯の炎や灰による変化を生かす。
whatEn: Rui Mitoh’s Karatsu-yaki kiln in Uki, established independently in 2009. She works from finding clay through to firing, using the effects of flame and ash in a climbing kiln.
note: ぐい呑は、土と釉薬の違いを見ながら選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose a sake cup by looking at the differences in clay and glaze.

name: 曹源窯
what: 浜玉町平原の、小島直喜の唐津焼窯元。自ら採った土や釉薬の原料を使い、登り窯のほか、作品に応じてガス窯や電気窯でも焼く。
whatEn: Naoki Kojima’s Karatsu-yaki kiln in Hirabaru, Hamatama. He gathers his own clay and glaze materials, firing in a climbing kiln or in gas and electric kilns according to the work.
note: 色だけでなく、手に持った土の感触で選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose by the feel of the clay in my hands, as well as its colour.

name: 由起子窯
what: 浜玉町東山田の、土屋由起子の唐津焼窯元。黒唐津の器を作る。
whatEn: Yukiko Tsuchiya’s Karatsu-yaki kiln in Higashiyamada, Hamatama, making black-glazed Kuro-Garatsu tableware.
note: 黒い器に何を盛るか、食卓を考えながら選ぶ。
noteEn: I would choose a black vessel while thinking about what to serve in it.

name: うつわギャラリー 唐津 草伝社
what: 北波多徳須恵の、唐津焼と有田焼のギャラリー。国登録文化財の旧商家・旧井手邸で、器の展示や企画展を開く。
whatEn: A gallery for Karatsu and Arita ware in Kitahata Tokusue. Exhibitions in the former Ide merchant house, a registered tangible cultural property.
note: 唐津焼と有田焼を並べて、食卓の器を選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose tableware by looking at Karatsu and Arita pieces side by side.

name: 古道具 caesura
what: 大石町の、珈琲とビールが飲める古道具店。開く日時は公式Instagramで知らせる。
whatEn: An antique shop in Oishimachi serving coffee and beer. Opening dates and hours are posted on its official Instagram.
note: 古道具を見たあとは、ここで珈琲を飲みたい。
noteEn: After looking at the antiques, I would sit here for coffee.

name: Viennoiserie selfish
what: 船宮町のベーカリー。佐賀県産小麦と唐津産の卵・牛乳を使う。
whatEn: A bakery in Funamiyamachi using Saga-grown wheat and eggs and milk from Karatsu.
note: 地元の小麦と卵を使うパンを、おやつに選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose bread made with local wheat and eggs for a snack.

name: LAZY BIRD BAKERY
what: 唐津城のそば、東城内のパン屋。売り切れ次第閉店で、月・木曜は休み。
whatEn: A bakery near Karatsu Castle in Higashi-Jonai. It closes when sold out; closed on Mondays and Thursdays.
note: 城のそばでパンを一つ選んで、持ち帰りたい。
noteEn: I would choose something from this bakery near the castle to take away.

name: Patisserie ANN
what: 鏡の、韓国人パティシエが営むケーキ店とカフェ。店内でも食べられ、ドリンクメニューもある。
whatEn: A cake shop and café in Kagami run by a Korean pastry chef. Cakes can be eaten inside, with a drinks menu too.
note: ケーキを一つ選んで、店内でお茶にしたい。
noteEn: I would choose one cake and sit inside for tea.

name: 川島豆腐店
what: 寛政年間創業の、京町の豆腐店。予約制の食事処では、唐津焼の器で温かいざる豆腐や厚揚げなどの豆腐料理を出す。
whatEn: A tofu shop in Kyomachi founded in the Kansei era, 1789–1801. Its dining counter serves warm zaru-dofu and tofu dishes including thick fried tofu on Karatsu ware, by reservation.
note: 温かいざる豆腐を、唐津焼の器で食べたい。
noteEn: I would choose warm zaru-dofu served in Karatsu ware.

name: QURIYA 厨
what: 東城内のイタリア料理店。海や山の食材を使うパスタやリゾット、肉料理があり、昼と夜に開く。
whatEn: An Italian restaurant in Higashi-Jonai. Pasta, risotto and meat dishes using ingredients from sea and land, at lunch and dinner.
note: おまかせのパスタに、グラスワインを合わせたい。
noteEn: I would pair the chef’s choice pasta with a glass of wine.

name: レストラン シマ
what: 原の、唐津の食材を使うフランス料理店。前菜や主菜を選べるランチコースと、夜のコースがある。
whatEn: A French restaurant in Haru using Karatsu ingredients. Lunch courses with a choice of starters and main dishes, and dinner courses.
note: 昼の主菜は、唐津の魚を使う一皿にしたい。
noteEn: For the lunch main, I would choose a dish of Karatsu fish.

name: Restaurant Présage
what: 新興町の予約制レストラン。昼と夜に営業し、2名から、2日前までの予約を受け付ける。
whatEn: A restaurant in Shinkomachi open for lunch and dinner by reservation. Book at least two days ahead, for two or more people.
note: 二人で予約して、ゆっくり昼の食事にしたい。
noteEn: I would book for two and make it a leisurely lunch.

name: Jack Coffeestand
what: 浜崎の、ウインドサーフィン店WIND JACKと並ぶコーヒースタンド。珈琲とマフィンを出し、木・金曜は休み。
whatEn: A coffee stand alongside the windsurfing shop WIND JACK in Hamasaki. Coffee and muffins; closed on Thursdays and Fridays.
note: ここではマフィンを一つ、珈琲と合わせたい。
noteEn: Here I would have a muffin with my coffee.

name: cafe ortoyo
what: 和多田本村のカフェ。シフォンケーキを中心に焼き菓子を出し、食事メニューは準備中。
whatEn: A café in Watada Honmura serving chiffon cakes and other baked sweets. The meal menu is still in preparation.
note: 焼き菓子も気になるけれど、まずはシフォンを選ぶ。
noteEn: The baked sweets appeal too, but I would start with chiffon cake.

name: タネ屋珈琲店
what: 熊原町の、焼き芋も扱う珈琲店。持ち帰りにも対応する。
whatEn: A coffee shop in Kumanoharamachi that also sells roasted sweet potatoes. Takeaway is available.
note: 焼き芋をおやつに、珈琲を一杯合わせたい。
noteEn: I would have a roasted sweet potato for a snack, with a cup of coffee.
